senses.gloss:
वेशः [विश्-घञ्]
1 Entrance.
--2
Ingress, access.
--3 A house,
dwelling.
--4 A house or residence of
prostitutes; तरुणजनसहायश्चिंत्यतां
वेशवासः Mk. 1. 31.
--5 Dress,
apparel (also written वेष in this sense);
मृग यावेषधारी; विनीतवेषेण Ś. 1;
कृतवेशे केशवे Gīt. 11.
--6 Disguise.
--7
Hire, wages.
--दानः the sun-flower.
--धारिन् a. disguised. (--m.) {1} a
hypocrite, false ascetic. {2} an actor.
--नारी, --वनिता a harlot;
Mu. 3. 10.
--वासः the residence of harlots.

वेश्मन्^1 n. [विश्-मनिन्] A house,
dwelling, an abode, a mansion,
palace; R. 14. 15; Me. 25;
Ms. 4. 73, 9. 85.
--Comp.
--कर्मन् n.
house-building.
--कलिंगः a kind
of sparrow.
--नकुलः the musk-rat.
--भूः f. the site of a habitation,
building-ground.
--स्थूणा the main
post of a house.
[1] Correction submitted by User geymonat on 20200217. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/131.

वेश्यं^1 [विश्-ण्यत् वेशाय हितं वा यत्]
1 The habitation of harlots.
--2
Ved. Abode, residence.
[1] Correction submitted by User geymonat on 20200217. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/131.

वेश्या A harlot, prostitute,
courtezan, concubine; त्वं वापीव लतेव नौरिव
जनं वेश्यासि सर्वं भज Mk. 1. 32;
Me. 35, Y. 1. 141.
--Comp.
--आचार्यः {1} the master or keeper of
prostitutes. {2} a pimp. {3}
a catamite.
--आश्रयः
habitation of harlots.
--गमनं
debauchery, whoring.
--गृहं a brothel.
--जनः a harlot.
--पणः the wages
given to a prostitute.

वेष्ट्^1 {c1c} A. (वेष्टते)
1 To surround,
enclose, encompass, envelop.
--2 To wind or twist round.
--3 To
dress. --Caus. (वेष्टयति-ते)
1 To
surround &c.
--2 To blockade.
--WITH आ to fold.
--परि, --सं to
fold together, clasp or wind round.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.

वेष्टः [वेष्ट्-घञ् अच् वा]
1
Surrounding, enclosing.
--2 An
enclosure, a fence.
--3 A
turban.
--4 Gum resin, exudation.
--5 Turpentine.
--Comp.
--वंशः
a kind of bamboo.
--सारः
turpentine.

वेष्टकः [वेष्ट्-ण्वुल्]
1 An enclosure,
a fence.
--2 A pumpkin-gourd.
--कं
1 A turban.
--2 A wrapper,
mantle.
--3 Gum, exudation.
--4
Turpentine.

वेष्टनं [वेष्ट्-ल्युट्]
1 Encompassing,
encircling, surrounding; अंगुलिवेष्टनं
‘a finger-ring.’
--2 Coiling round,
twisting round; भोगिवेष्टनमार्गेषु
चंदनानां समर्पितं R. 4. 48.
--3 An
[]
envelope, a wrapper, cover, covering,
case.
--4 A turban, tiara;
अस्पृष्टालकवेष्टनौ R. 1. 42; शिरसा वेष्टन शोभिना
8. 12.
--5 An enclosure, a fence;
क्रीडाशैलः कनककदलीवेष्टनप्रेक्षणीयः
Me. 77.
--6 A girdle, zone.
--7 A
bandage.
--8 The outer ear.
--9
Bdellium.
--10 A particular attitude
in dancing.
--11 Grasping, seizing.

वेष्टनकः A particular position in
copulation.

वेष्टित p. p. [वेष्ट्-क्त]
1
Surrounded, enclosed, encircled, enveloped.
--2 Wrapped up, dressed.
--3
Stopped, blocked, impeded.
--4
Blockaded, invested.
--तं
1 Encircling,
surrounding.
--2 One of the
attitudes of dancing.

वेस(श)वारः A particular
condiment (consisting of ground
coriander, mustard, pepper,
ginger &c.).

वेस(श)वारः A particular
condiment (consisting of ground
coriander, mustard, pepper,
ginger &c.).
